title: Use the 'Overall System AGV Status' popup to identify AGVs with errors and view destination/error details
summary: Use the HMI popup labeled “Overall System AGV Status” to quickly identify which AGVs currently have errors. The popup’s top section lists detailed fields for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors), while the bottom section shows only AGVs with errors along with additional destination/error detail.
when_to_use: When you need to identify which AGVs currently have errors and read their associated destination and error details from the “Overall System AGV Status” popup.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the “Overall System AGV Status” popup on the HMI and extract the erroring AGV IDs plus their destination/error details from the popup sections.
access_or_tools_needed: HMI access to the “Overall System AGV Status” popup

access_required: Access to the HMI screen that contains the “Overall System AGV Status” popup
system_preconditions: The “Overall System AGV Status” popup must be visible so that the top section fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) and the bottom error-focused section are readable

visual_references.description: Frame showing the “Overall System AGV Status” popup with the top section (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) and bottom section (only AGVs with errors with additional detail).

steps.title: Open the 'Overall System AGV Status' popup on the HMI
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that contains the AGV list and the error-focused section needed to identify erroring AGVs.
steps.instruction: On the HMI, open the popup/screen labeled “Overall System AGV Status”.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System AGV Status” popup is visible with a top section showing AGV details and a bottom section dedicated to error cases.
steps.healthy_condition: Both the top section (detailed info for all AGVs) and the bottom section (only AGVs with errors with additional details) are visible.
steps.failure_condition: The popup is not visible, or the screen does not show both the top and bottom sections.

actions.label: Open Overall System AGV Status popup
actions.exact_action: Open the “Overall System AGV Status” popup on the HMI.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the popup cannot be opened or the top/bottom sections are not visible, stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Another pop up shows you detailed information for all the Agvs, status, destination errors. So only Agvs with errors with additional detail will appear.”
source_evidence.retrieval_text: Training video slide frame captured at 02:10:23.000. Transcript near this frame: So, so we have AGB status again. Another pop up shows you detailed information for all the Agvs, status, destination errors. So only Agvs with errors with additional detail will appear.
source_evidence.ocr_text: Overall System AGV Status * Top Section: Detailed info for all AGVs - ID, -_ Status, Destination, and Errors ... * Bottom Section: Only AGVs with errors, with additional details will appear.

steps.title: Verify the top section fields: ID, Status, Destination, Errors
steps.purpose: Confirm the popup contains the required columns/fields so you can interpret which AGVs have errors.
steps.instruction: In the top section of the “Overall System AGV Status” popup, locate the fields/columns labeled “ID”, “Status”, “Destination”, and “Errors”.
steps.expected_result: The top section displays the AGV fields “ID”, “Status”, “Destination”, and “Errors”.
steps.healthy_condition: The headers/fields “ID”, “Status”, “Destination”, and “Errors” are readable in the top section.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the expected fields/headers (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) are missing or not displayed.

actions.label: Check top section headers
actions.exact_action: Locate the columns/fields for each AGV: ID, Status, Destination, Errors.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the popup does not display the expected fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors), stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR identifies the top section fields as “ID, Status, Destination, and Errors”.
source_evidence.retrieval_text: Training video slide frame captured at 02:10:23.000. Transcript near this frame: ... detailed information for all the Agvs, status, destination errors ...
source_evidence.ocr_text: Overall System AGV Status * Top Section: Detailed info for all AGVs - ID, -_ Status, Destination, and Errors ...

steps.title: Confirm the bottom section lists only AGVs with errors
steps.purpose: Ensure the error-focused list is filtered correctly so you can rely on it to identify erroring AGVs.
steps.instruction: In the bottom section of the “Overall System AGV Status” popup, confirm it shows only AGVs with errors (i.e., error cases) and that it is presented as an error-focused list with additional detail.
steps.expected_result: The bottom section contains only AGVs that have errors, and it is clearly the error-focused area with additional detail.
steps.healthy_condition: The bottom section is populated only with AGVs that have errors; non-error AGVs are not listed there.
steps.failure_condition: The bottom section is empty when errors are expected, or it shows AGVs that do not have errors.

actions.label: Check bottom section filter behavior
actions.exact_action: Confirm that the bottom section shows only AGVs with errors with additional detail.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the bottom section does not show only AGVs with errors (e.g., appears empty while errors are expected, or shows non-error AGVs), stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR identifies the bottom section as “Only AGVs with errors, with additional details will appear.”
source_evidence.retrieval_text: Training video slide frame captured at 02:10:23.000. Transcript near this frame: ... So only Agvs with errors with additional detail will appear.
source_evidence.ocr_text: Overall System AGV Status * Bottom Section: Only AGVs with errors, with additional details will appear.

steps.title: Identify erroring AGVs by matching Errors in the top section to the bottom error-focused list
steps.purpose: Determine which AGVs currently have errors and ensure the erroring AGVs are correctly reflected in the bottom section.
steps.instruction: In the top section, identify AGVs with non-empty/active entries in the “Errors” field, then cross-check that those same AGVs appear in the bottom error-focused section.
steps.expected_result: Every AGV shown in the bottom error-focused section corresponds to an AGV with errors in the top section’s “Errors” field.
steps.healthy_condition: The set of AGVs with errors in the top section matches the set of AGVs listed in the bottom section.
steps.failure_condition: An AGV appears in the bottom section without errors in the top section, or an AGV with errors in the top section is missing from the bottom section.

actions.label: Cross-check erroring AGVs
actions.exact_action: Identify which AGVs have non-empty/active entries in the Errors field (top section) and cross-check those AGVs appear in the bottom error-focused section.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the bottom section does not align with the top section’s “Errors” field (missing or extra AGVs), stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The popup is described as having a top section with “Errors” and a bottom section that shows only AGVs with errors with additional detail.
source_evidence.ocr_text: Top Section: ... Destination, and Errors ... Bottom Section: Only AGVs with errors, with additional details will appear.

steps.title: Read destination and error details for each AGV listed in the bottom error-focused section
steps.purpose: Capture the actionable context (destination and error details) for each currently erroring AGV.
steps.instruction: For each AGV listed in the bottom error-focused section, read the associated destination and error-related details shown there.
steps.expected_result: For each AGV in the bottom section, you can report its destination and error-related details from the popup.
steps.healthy_condition: Each bottom-section row provides destination and error-related detail for the corresponding erroring AGV.
steps.failure_condition: Bottom-section rows do not provide destination/error detail, or the details are not readable/available.

actions.label: Extract destination/error details
actions.exact_action: Read the associated destination and error-related details shown in the bottom error-focused section for each listed AGV.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the popup does not provide destination/error detail for the AGVs shown in the bottom section, stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The popup provides destination and errors in the top section and “only AGVs with errors with additional detail” in the bottom section.
source_evidence.ocr_text: Top Section: ... Destination, and Errors ... Bottom Section: Only AGVs with errors, with additional details will appear.

success_criteria: You can identify the set of AGVs with errors using the bottom error-focused section.
For each AGV listed in the bottom section, you can read and report its destination and error-related details from the popup.
healthy_conditions: Bottom section lists only AGVs with errors and provides additional detail.
failure_conditions: Bottom section does not show only AGVs with errors (empty when errors expected, or includes non-error AGVs).
Popup does not display expected fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors).
Mismatch between AGVs with errors in the top section and the AGVs listed in the bottom section.
escalation_guidance: If the bottom section filter behavior is incorrect or the expected fields are missing, stop and escalate for further investigation.
